open_questions: Fabric and Null Core stay in system 1 (dead-world logic); should they also be buildable in any cell?
Design default: each workshop is built once per run, the player picks the cell. Should it instead be one per cell (each cell its own Munitions Line)?
Next cycle numbers (engine.project_storage) never included workshop output or input, so no per-cell workshop forecast exists. Add one?
handoff: Market workshops are now built from the cell view of any established system. Every cell lists a Build button for each visible, unbuilt workshop (disabled with cash short). Once built the workshop shows (recipes, status) only in its own cell, and reads/writes that cell's storage. Workshops.system saved per workshop; old saves load as system 1. can_build_workshop(id, sid) and build_workshop(id, sid) default to system 1, so bots still work. NOT_WORKSHOP_BUILT now says built in {system}. Cell view has _build_blocks() calling _workshop_rows(): a portal block goes beside it. Tests: 1774 pass, 0 fail.

details.how_to_try: Debug menu: give MIL_1 + FND_STORAGE, open system 2, click the Space Storage of system 2, press Build Munitions Line. Or run qa/run_game.sh res://qa/bots/workshop_cell_shot.gd.
details.easy_to_change: One-per-run rule is the `workshops.built[id]` check in main.can_build_workshop; the list filter is in space_storage_view._workshop_rows.
details.screenshot: qa/reports/workshop_cell.png shows system 2 (Dunmere Reach) cell with Workshops title and enabled Build Munitions Line (900 cr), hidden Logic Cores row not drawn. Not verified: built-state look in the windowed game, a second cell side by side.
